title: Unify spacing behavior and token bridge for charts, tables, and buttons
creator: Ava Martinez
description:
Background: Over the past two quarters we’ve accumulated several ad-hoc spacing fixes inside the Figma library: chart frames with mixed padding units, table row containers that override parent auto-layout gaps, and button variants that use different token names for the same semantic intent. This has led to inconsistent rendering in the Console and extra work for engineers during handoff.

Goal: Normalize spacing/autolayout behavior across chart, table, and button primitives; create a lightweight token-bridge strategy so older token names continue to map to the new semantic tokens; and publish a clean library version with clear migration notes.

Scope:
- Audit representative components: chart-legend, chart-panel, table-row, table-header, primary/secondary/small button variants.
- Standardize outer padding, inter-item gap, and horizontal vs vertical token usage.
- Consolidate duplicated token names into new semantic tokens (e.g., spacing-xxs / spacing-xs / spacing-sm) and map legacy tokens via token-bridge aliases.
- Adjust auto-layout constraints to remove overlapping nested gaps and ensure predictable resizing.
- Produce a publish checklist and migration doc for engineers (mapping table + examples).

Acceptance criteria:
- All audited components use the canonical spacing token set or an explicit alias in the token-bridge mapping.
- No component overrides parent gaps in a way that causes inconsistent resizing (verified by the QA checklist).
- Figma library branch publishes without broken instances; change log includes mapping table and screenshots.
- Engineering review sign-off confirming the mapping is implementable with runtime-1.18 token names and will not add runtime regressions.
comments: 2025-01-18 — Ava Martinez: Kickoff. Ran an initial audit and pulled 18 instances across charts/tables/buttons that violate expected spacing. Uploaded audit CSV to Drive: https://drive.google.com/drive/folders/figma-audit-33107

2025-01-21 — Jordan Lee: Proposed token set and token-bridge draft posted in Confluence: https://confluence.redwood/infradesign/spacing-bridge. Suggested canonical tokens: spacing-xxs, spacing-xs, spacing-sm, spacing-md, spacing-lg.

2025-01-24 — Ava Martinez: Reworked chart-panel to use spacing-sm outer padding and chart-gap spacing-xs for inner items. Left notes on the component page describing constraints changes and screenshots for visual diff.

2025-01-28 — Design review: PM Nora Chen + Eng lead Carlos Duarte joined. Agreed on token names and migration strategy: do aliases in Figma tokens and expose a migration table for engineers. Action: Jordan to open PR for the component update & add unit examples.

2025-01-30 — Jordan Lee: Opened GitHub PR for Figma-to-Token export adjustments and a small publish automation fix. PR: https://github.com/redwood-inference/design-system/pull/428 (draft). Linked PR in Linear ticket. Noted that engineers will need a flag in the runtime to support token aliasing for one release cycle.

2025-02-03 — QA pass: Ran instances check script against the draft library; 3 table-row instances still reference legacy token table-row-gap-8. Added sub-task to replace those references and updated the audit spreadsheet.

2025-02-05 — Decision: For backwards compatibility, we will keep legacy token names in the token set but mark them deprecated and add bridging comments. Migration doc updated with automated search-and-replace recommendation for engineering during rollout.

2025-02-06 — Jordan Lee: Preparing publish branch: ds/clean-spacing-33107. Added publish checklist (version bump, snapshot test run, PR to design-system repo). Scheduling library publish on 2025-02-12 to coincide with runtime-1.18 deploy window.
